profile.name: UXBus TCP/Modbus 通信协议组件
profile.description: 这是一个非实体的软件通信组件，用于通过 TCP 封装、发送和解析 UXBus/Modbus 请求与响应报文。它提供线圈、离散输入、保持寄存器和输入寄存器的读写操作，适合在实验自动化系统中把上层控制程序与支持该协议的网络设备连接起来。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that packages, sends, and parses UXBus/Modbus request and response frames over TCP. It provides read/write access to coils, discrete inputs, holding registers, and input registers, and is used in lab automation to connect higher-level control software to networked devices that speak this protocol.

registry.name: UFACTORY Uxbus Cmd Tcp
registry.description: UFACTORY Uxbus Cmd Tcp是由UFACTORY (xArm)生产的机械臂，主要功能包括写入数据、日志记录、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, check private protocol等操作。
